title: Full Grass
description: 100% JSON-based Full Grass overlay. Contains no .png textures, allowing it to dynamically match and combine with any resource pack without overwriting their grass styles. Place at the top of your list.
body:
🌿 Multi-Compatible Full Grass Resource Pack
Tired of ugly dirt sides ruining your landscape, but don't want to give up your favorite texture pack? This pack is the solution!

Unlike standard Full Grass packs that permanently overwrite the side textures, this pack is built as a smart overlay.

✨ Key Features:
Universal Compatibility: Can be stacked and combined with any other resource pack or texture style you use.

Smart Texture Matching: It dynamically takes the grass top texture from your active resource pack and applies it to the sides.

No More Mismatch: You never have to worry about the side grass looking out of place or clashing with your main textures. It blends perfectly!

100% JSON-Based Code: This pack contains zero .png texture files. It uses 100% JSON code to tell the game how to render the blocks, making it extremely lightweight and perfectly compatible with any resolution (16x, 32x, 64x, etc.).

🛠️ How to Install (For Full Compatibility):
Go to the Resource Packs menu in Minecraft.

Place this Full Grass pack at the very top of your active list (above your favorite texture pack).

Click Done and enjoy a cleaner, greener world!

Note: For the best visual transitions, make sure to enable Better Grass in OptiFine or use equivalent mods like Continuity / LambBetterGrass if you are on Fabric/Quilt.
